description: This file is a build script intended for automating the cloning, configuring, and installing of various CCSP components from a git repository. It defines a function execute_component() that takes user parameters to determine which component to build, with a series of tailored build commands for each component, and outputs a list of component names at the end.

methods.name: execute_component
methods.description: A shell function that takes input parameters to determine which CCSP component to clone, configure, build, and install. It uses a case statement for different component options, executing the corresponding sequence of commands.
